# Keep the undo option available when users briefly leave the list

## What & Why
The deletion recovery notice is intentionally short-lived and currently belongs to the answer or application page. Users who navigate away before clicking Undo lose that recovery option, even though the deletion was recent.

## Done looks like
- A recent answer or application deletion can still be undone after navigating between the main workspace pages
- The recovery entry expires after a clear short window and cannot restore stale data
- Restoring still preserves the complete original entry and its original position
